# Koodisi

Streamlining Enterprise Automation

[Talk To Us!](https://www.ivoyant.com/contact)

![Koodisi product image](https://www.ivoyant.com/_astro/koodisi-productImage.XbTTy1d-_123OEH.webp)

Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS that connects CRM, ERP, HRMS, ITSM, and 100+ business systems through no-code workflow automation with built-in API management. For teams managing integrations across multiple clients or environments, tenant isolation, RBAC, SAML/OAuth, and per-client dashboards are on the Enterprise tier.

![koodisi featured image](https://www.ivoyant.com/_astro/69f3215eaa021d082f662da1_koodisi-featured-image.ApEzwnig_Z1jfe2j.webp)

## Features

- **100+ pre-built connectors** — Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, HubSpot, NetSuite Jira, Slack, and more. No custom code to connect them.
- **No-code visual workflow builder** — drag-and-drop canvas designed for operations and business teams, not just developers.
- **Five-agent AI pipeline** — dedicated agents for requirements, architecture, build, governance review, and live support across the full delivery lifecycle.
- **Built-in API management**— token-based security, rate limiting, and client profile included. No third-party gateway needed.
- **Governance on every plan** — approval gates, versioning, rollback, and RBAC built in. Notsold separately.
- **Multi-tenant isolation**— scoped credentials, dedicated audit trails, and branded per-client dashboards for MSPs and enterprise teams.
- **Step-level observability** — structured logs, metrics, and execution traces. Support teams see what failed, where, and why — without digging through raw logs.
- **Structured deployment pipeline** — Dev → Test → Promote lifecycle keeps production changes controlled and reversible.
